rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a bicycle in everyday Hong Kong speech.

example.english: I often bicycle to the beach on weekends.
example.traditional: 我週末成日踩單車去海邊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zau1 mut6 sing4 jat6 caai2 daan1 ce1 heoi3 hoi2 bin1

rows.note: A speaker uses this mainly in formal or written contexts rather than ordinary conversation.

example.english: The school requires students not to ride a bicycle back to school.
example.traditional: 校方規定學生唔可以騎自行車返校。
example.jyutping: haau6 fong1 kwai1 ding6 hok6 saang1 m4 ho2 ji5 kei4 zi6 hang4 ce1 faan1 haau6
